score_notes.A: The arc works (attack surface L11, injection L55, jailbreak L176, poisoning L198, tool/MCP L286, benchmarks L334, defenses L426, adaptive loop L520, comparison L550, open problems L596, conclusion L620). No body H1 and no skipped levels. But two lineage sections are cut off: L180 stops mid-sentence ('탈옥은 이와 달리 모델이') and is followed only by four figures (L182-196). L292 stops mid-word ('탈취한 정보를 담는 Data') and is followed by ten figures with no prose (L294-332). The writer's revision notes are left in the post body at L632-649 ('E234 반복 제거', '**수정 내역**', '제시하신 대로 연도를 넣었습니다'). A lone currency '$0.026' sits in a table cell at L578, which breaks the no-single-$ rule.
score_notes.B: Mostly natural 입니다 register. One register break, in the L182 caption: '...ASR을 보여 준다'. Hedges about the input sit in the prose: L264 '(보고된 수치만으로는 상대값인지 %p인지 구분되지 않습니다)', repeated at L264 '(이 역시 상대·절대 구분 없이 보고된 값입니다)', and L380 '논문의 이 문장은 어느 모델 기준인지 ... 밝히지 않습니다'. Rewrite: give the figure as the paper gives it ('정상 성능 하락은 평균 0.74%') and drop the meta comment. '이 글의 판단으로는' appears 7 times (L284, L424, L518, L542, L568, L610, L630). English is left in a table cell: L594 'AHR@5', and L591 'tool filter 8건' (use '도구 필터 8건').
score_notes.C: The email-assistant example ties the sections together. Back-references point to material that was never written: L526-L538 lean on SmoothLLM and PAIR ('PAIR가 SmoothLLM을 비켜 간 이유와 같습니다'), but the jailbreak section never explains either one. L545 'PAIR·TAP류' and L602 'Prompt Infection은 다중 에이전트 감염 실험에서' cite results the truncated section never presents. L568 tells the reader to read '유용성 열' and '보장 열' and to compare rows by '공격자 접근 권한', but the table at L570 has only 논문/계보/주요 결과/한계.
score_notes.D: The hard parts get real help. The M-GCG/T-GCG mechanics come with the email mapping (L150-160). PoisonedRAG has a worked hypothetical (L224). The SecAlign loss has a numeric example (L476). The CaMeL walk-through is at L498. Hedging is over-explained (L162 last two sentences, L264), and the reader gets no help at all on jailbreaks or MCP.
score_notes.E: There are 45 figures. 14 of them stand alone with no discussion (L182-196, L294-332). Several captions use the paper's numbering: L182 '그림 3:', L294 '그림 1:', L298 '그림 6(a):', L302 '그림 4:', L306 '그림 7:', L314 '그림 7은'. The comparison table has a real structure and equal cell counts, but many cells repeat body numbers (StruQ L448/L579, SecAlign L488/L586, AgentHarm L410/L588, CaMeL L504/L591, PoisonedRAG L226/L580).
score_notes.F: Most body numbers matched the full texts (see claims). Wrong: the L576 GCG cell gives '유해 문자열 ASR 88% (GCG, 화이트박스, Vicuna-7B/Llama-2-7B-Chat ...)', but 88% on Harmful Strings is Vicuna-7B only; Llama-2-7B-Chat is 57%, and its 88% is on Harmful Behaviors. Unsupported as stated: the L587 Prompt Infection cell omits the comparison basis. 66% vs 9% is the share of self-replicating attacks that are ignored, and +13.92%/+209% are the gains of self-replicating over non-replicating infection; the cell reads as absolute ASR changes. Scope issue: L504 places the abstract's 77%/84% inside the Claude 3.5 Sonnet comparison paragraph. ToolHijacker's limitation cell L594 states a result.
score_notes.S1: Limitation cells: '-' for BadAgent L583 and SecAlign L586. ToolHijacker L594 gives '기존 방어 불충분', which is a finding, not a limitation. HouYi L574 gives '일부 앱 저항', also a finding. GCG L576 gives '증류 모델 편향', which is cryptic. The Indirect PI result cell L573 is '정량 수치 없음'. Cells repeat model and condition in the value and in the parenthetical (L574, L579, L581, L594). Numbers explained in the body come back in the table, against the rule that the table owns the numbers.

claim_headings.evidence: All H2 and H3 headings are claim noun phrases, e.g. L238 '임베딩 공간의 빈 구석에 트리거를 숨기는 AgentPoison', L490 '모델이 속아도 흐름은 지키는 CaMeL'. None is in 다-form, and the headings use Korean terms.

running_example.evidence: The email assistant from L15 recurs at L89, L150, L224, L240, L348, L374, L446, L498, L556 and L604.

mechanism_choice_formula_example.evidence: Full chain for Adaptive IPI (L142-160), PoisonedRAG (L212-224) and SecAlign (L468-476). Missing for every jailbreak and tool/MCP paper, whose sections are truncated (L180, L292).

facts_said_once.evidence: CaMeL's text-to-text exclusion is stated at L510, L516, L566, L614 and L628. AgentHarm's single-turn limit at L418, L424, L616 and L628. AgentHarm's custom tools at L418 and L618. The AgentDojo 25%/8% figures at L386 and L394. Body numbers come back in the table (L579, L586, L588, L591).

numbers_with_scope_unit.evidence: Body numbers mostly carry model and setting (e.g. L166). Exceptions: L581 '기본 ASR 6.6' has no unit, L578 'GPT 50%' does not name the model version, L587 '+13.92%' has no comparison basis, and L577 'GCG ASR 최고 수준 감소' is vague.

nothing_invented.evidence: The hypothetical examples are labelled ('가상의', L224, L348, L446, L476). One misattributed table cell (L576 GCG). The writer's revision notes leaked into the body (L632-649).

writer_assessment_at_end.evidence: L610 and L630 give a concrete judgment: fix the permission and data-flow boundary first, then add model-level defenses.

length_fitted.evidence: About 65k non-space characters. Defenses and benchmarks are deep, while the jailbreak lineage (L176-196) and the tool/MCP lineage (L286-332) have one or two sentences of prose each.

type_specific_shape.evidence: Has the timeline (L28), the lineage sections, a cross-cutting section (L520), the comparison (L550-594), insights (L596) and a conclusion (L620). Numbers are not owned by the single table: they are given in full in the body and then repeated in the table.

korean_style.evidence: Natural 입니다 register with varied sentences. One 한다-form caption (L182). The input hedges (L264, L380) and the 7x '이 글의 판단으로는' read as formulaic. The leaked notes L634-647 are addressed to an editor ('제시하신 대로').

length.note: Long for a survey and unevenly distributed: defenses (L426-518) and benchmarks (L334-424) are deep, while two of six lineages have one to two sentences.

top_issues: Two of the six lineage sections are cut off mid-sentence (L180 jailbreak, L292 tool/MCP), followed by 14 figures with no text; GCG, SmoothLLM, PAIR, Jailbroken, AiTM, ETDI and MCP Attack Vectors get no card.

Comparison-table defects: GCG 88% misattributed to Llama-2-7B-Chat (L576); Prompt Infection gains with no basis (L587); '-' limitations (L583, L586); ToolHijacker and HouYi limitations that are results (L594, L574); model and condition repeated in each cell; lone '$0.026' (L578).
Dangling references to unexplained material: SmoothLLM/PAIR (L526, L538, L545), Prompt Infection results (L602), and non-existent table columns (L568).

Facts are repeated and gap claims are not scoped: CaMeL's text-to-text exclusion five times (L510, L516, L566, L614, L628), AgentHarm single-turn four times, body numbers repeated in the table; field-wide 'not studied' statements (L616, L618, L288). Also paper-numbered figure captions (L182, L294-314) and input hedges (L264, L380).
